description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Revenue Protection Order No. 02/2022
categorisation: This gazette content is a notification under the Customs Ordinance, specifically a Revenue Protection Order that modifies import duty rates for various goods. It establishes new legal/regulatory frameworks for customs duties and contains a detailed schedule of tariff changes, fitting the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) which cover "new laws, acts, ordinances, and regulations" and "regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements."
